name: Admin Proposal Section Disable/Enable Toggle
description: Admin toggles section visibility (is_enabled) from the Secciones tab of the proposal edit page. Each section row has an enable/disable toggle; disabled sections are greyed out in the admin list and excluded from the public proposal view. PATCH /api/proposals/sections/:id/update/ with { is_enabled: false }. Complements admin-proposal-section-reorder — both operations can be combined in sequence.
knownGaps: Admin side covered; no assertion that a disabled section disappears from the public view (2026-07 audit).
